copy.headline: No. 5 Texas avoids letdown, routs Arkansas 45-3 on Senior Day
copy.caption: Arch Manning accounted for three touchdowns and Jelani McDonald recorded a pick-six as the Longhorns extended their winning streak to a season-high five games, strengthening their College Football Playoff résumé.
